metadata.title: GGTT Reverse Engineering Claim Verification Matrix (Phase 9)

claims.description: Combo points calculate deltaCoins and deltaQuantity against previous streak, clamping negatives to 0. If deltaQuantity is 0, deltaCoins is clamped to 0.
claims.clean_room_implication: Implement exact Math.max(0, incoming - prev) logic with zero-quantity zero-coin guard.

claims.description: Recipient resolution follows strict 5-tier precedence: UI Override (Tier 1) -> Existing Combo Target (Tier 2) -> Sender Target (Tier 3) -> Round Rule Target (Tier 4) -> Pending (Tier 5).
claims.clean_room_implication: Enforce identical priority chain; abnormal or empty contexts must fall through to Tier 5 Pending without throwing.

claims.description: Streak combos reset to null when gift ID or streak breaks. State machine maintains streak continuity over time window.
claims.clean_room_implication: Reset combo tracking object to null on broken streak to avoid cross-gift accumulation.

claims.description: SQLite WAL journal mode with automatic pre-migration backup, optimistic concurrency via revision column, and transaction rollback on error.
claims.clean_room_implication: Treat transaction boundary as architectural specification test; drivers must ensure atomicity and rollback.

claims.description: Overlay synchronization emits JSON 'team_state' messages, debounced with a 250ms window via teamLastStateSent and teamStatePending async delay.
claims.clean_room_implication: Implement identical 250ms throttle with delayed async dispatch for high-frequency live events.

claims.claim_title: 14 HTTP MIME Mappings & Dynamic Port Hopping
claims.description: Embedded media HTTP server binds dynamically to ports 5000-5050 and resolves exactly 14 file extensions, defaulting to application/octet-stream.
claims.clean_room_implication: Provide identical 14-entry MIME lookup dictionary with application/octet-stream fallback and port scan.

claims.description: Injected WebView2 scripts must not exceed 1MB (1,048,576 bytes), must contain TikLangJz and communicate_launcher tokens, and match SHA-256 hash.
claims.clean_room_implication: Pre-validate embedded payload size and cryptographic hash before executing inside WebView2.

claims.claim_title: Scenario Engine Queue Bound 256 & State Arithmetic
claims.description: ScenarioEngine limits pending action queue to 256 items, handles cancel_pending, and clamps add_state values to [-1000000, 1000000].
claims.clean_room_implication: Hard-cap scenario action execution at 256 items per tick; clamp state mutations between -1M and +1M.

claims.claim_title: Squat Counter Angle Thresholds & OBS v5 Auth
claims.description: Squat counting cycles through STANDING (>160 deg) -> DESCENDING (<140 deg) -> SQUATTING (<=100 deg) -> STANDING. OBS v5 uses SHA256 challenge-response.
claims.clean_room_implication: Use exact floating point angle transitions (160/140/100) and standard OBS WebSocket v5 auth handshake.

claims.description: Win32 WM_HOTKEY message decodes modifier bits in low word (bits 0-15) and VK code in high word (bits 16-31). Emulates DirectX scancodes.
claims.clean_room_implication: Extract 16-bit words using bitwise masking (lParam & 0xFFFF, (lParam >>> 16) & 0xFFFF) to avoid sign extension.

claims.claim_title: SQLite live_ledger View Union All Aggregation
claims.description: View live_ledger aggregates completed ledger rows with uncommitted pending_gifts via UNION ALL to provide instantaneous stream score.
claims.clean_room_implication: Ensure live score queries read both persistent ledger and in-memory/transient pending gifts table.

claims.claim_title: EffectProcessTrust RSA Signature & Named Pipe Binding
claims.description: Studio handshake over regex-validated Named Pipe ^GGTT\.Studio\.Launch\..*\.[a-f0-9]{32}$, verifying executable sha256 against RSA-signed release manifest.
claims.clean_room_implication: Document security architecture for clean-room implementation; do not copy embedded RSA public key token 0x700061e8.
